paper.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. $50 notional at 1x, 0.05% taker fee per side, fill at the confirmation candle close. One open position per coin, traded only on the active timeframe (15m). An opposite signal closes the trade and flips. Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, stop, or take-profit.

paper_unconfirmed.note: Paper only — no real orders or API keys. Default $50 notional at 1x, 0.05% taker fee per side. Enters at the close of the candle when a new unconfirmed BUY?/SELL? first appears on the active timeframe (15m). One open position per coin. If that signal fades, the position stays open. On 15m, every new same-direction unconfirmed signal (including a pivot walk) adds another leg of the first leg's notional, with no fade required. On 5m, a fade is required before a same-direction add. Up to 4 adds (5 legs). An opposite unconfirmed signal closes the whole stack and flips. Positions are not closed on fade, timeout, stop, or take-profit.
